_metadata.name: JAIN (Deemed-to-be University) - Faculty of Engineering & Technology (FET)
_metadata.address: Jakkasandra Post, Kanakapura Taluk, Ramanagara District, Karnataka, India - 562112
_metadata.disclaimer: Digital twin dataset combining verified OpenStreetMap campus boundary coordinates, satellite imagery layout geometry, and official JAIN University FET 5-Floor Fire Escape Route Plans. Indoor layouts accurately reflect the physical annular building and room sequences.

buildings.name: Faculty of Engineering and Technology (FET)
buildings.description: Primary engineering complex with 5 levels, central amphitheater courtyard, and 4 radial wings.

buildings.name: The Colosseum (Indoor Sports Arena & Hall)
buildings.description: Grand multi-purpose sports pavilion, convocation hall, and indoor badminton/basketball courts.

buildings.name: International Cricket Stadium & Pavilion
buildings.description: Standard oval cricket pitch with seating pavilions and athletic tracks.

buildings.name: SBMJCE Dining Complex & Cafeteria
buildings.description: Central student dining hall, cafeteria kitchens, and outdoor dining courtyard.

buildings.name: University Administration & Student Services
buildings.description: Central admissions, registrar, chancellor's office, and student services bureau.

buildings.name: Student Residential Hostels Complex
buildings.description: Multi-block student dormitories with ground-floor barrier-free accessible rooms.

buildings.name: JIRS Aquatic Complex & Swimming Pool
buildings.description: Competition-standard swimming pool and aquatic training center.

buildings.name: Aerospace Propulsion & Wind Tunnel Labs
buildings.description: Aeronautical research hangar, supersonic wind tunnel, and propulsion testing bays.
